# project-room

> Project Room connects existing AI agents to share context, coordinate tasks and save results. Open source; connect through MCP or HTTP.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Uuriko/project-room): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://room.trydemigod.com): Official website and documentation.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
